pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:0.6: Ime kho pan' ayyāyo tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo bahupatte sannicayaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bahupatte sannicayaṃ karissanti. pattavaṇijjaṃ vā bhikkhuniyo karissanti āmattikāpaṇaṃ vā pasāressantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo pattasannicayaṃ karissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo pattasannicayaṃ karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī pattasannicayaṃ kareyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.7: tayo pattassa vaṇṇā, ukkaṭṭho patto majjhimo patto omako patto.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.9: aḍḍhāḷhakodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ vā tadūpiyaṃ vā byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.11: nāḷikodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.13: patthodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadūpiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.19: nissajjitabbo saṃghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.21: tāya bhikkhuniyā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.22: ayaṃ me ayye patto rattātikkanto nissaggiyo, imāhaṃ saṃghassa nissajjāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.27: ayaṃ patto itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā nissaggiyo saṃghassa nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.28: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.29: tāya bhikkhuniyā sambahulā bhikkhuniyo upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.30: ayaṃ me ayyāyo patto rattātikkanto nissaggiyo, imāhaṃ ayyānaṃ nissajjāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.35: ayaṃ patto itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā nissaggiyo ayyānaṃ nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.36: yadi ayyānaṃ pattakallaṃ, ayyāyo imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā dadeyyun ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.37: tāya bhikkhuniyā ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.1.38: ayaṃ me ayye patto rattātikkanto nissaggiyo,
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.2.11: nissaggiyaṃ pattaṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:2.3.2: anto aruṇaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati bhijjati acchinditvā gaṇhanti vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-np1:3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo nissaṭṭhapattaṃ na denti.
